reviews.review_title: Flying in for an early doors score
reviews.review_description:
Lots of vibrant neon visuals, very responsive controls, and plenty of customisation. The soundtrack is absolutely banging, which is a massive plus!

I do feel the game needs more of a purpose. I've been flying through hoops and collecting points, but to what end? You can just keep going indefinitely without any real challenge. I think it would benefit from objectives or a time-based mode, such as a battery that gradually depletes, forcing you to plan your route and improve your score before time runs out.

The game is still in early development, so I'm looking forward to seeing how it evolves. I'll happily increase my rating as more features and gameplay depth are added.

reviews.review_title: Needs a lot more to gain interest
reviews.review_description:
I could only go in for a short time, I know you’re supposed to be a drone, but it didn’t resonate with me.
It does need a little more to gain interest in this app.
Hopefully this gets some more TLC in the coming months.
